err.objective_gps_off: Objective GPS is switched off on this server. Follow the objective text instead.
err.objective_gps_none: There is no objective on your map right now, so there is nothing to show.
err.objective_gps_start: Drive to the mission start first: your GPS shows the way there.
err.objective_gps_silence: Radio Silence: no GPS to the objective. Find it on your map.
admin.map_markers.subtitle: How the objective and every other part of a mission show on the officers' maps: the objective's look, then each part with its own switch, look and who sees it. Every change saves like any setting and works at once.
admin.map_markers.master_on: On: {n} of {total} extra parts show on the minimap and the big map
admin.map_markers.master_off: Off: no extra parts show ({n} of {total} are ready to show when you turn it on). The prisoner van and tow truck follow their own switch
admin.map_markers.fair: Fair play is kept: a real player suspect's own position never shows (a live case shows only its last-reported points), nothing hidden shows before it is found, and Radio Silence still hides people and cars.
admin.map_markers.empty: No map marker part settings were found. Check Config.Markers.parts in config/config.lua.
admin.map_markers.parts_hint: Switch a part on, pick its look and, if you want, who sees it. A part without rules shows to every officer on the run. The prisoner van and tow truck show while their own switch is on; every other part also needs the switch above.
admin.map_markers.look.label: Name on the map
admin.map_markers.hint.prisonerVan: The prisoner van coming to you. Shows in every Radio Silence mode while it is on (shipped on).
admin.map_markers.hint.prisonerDrop: Where the prisoner van waits for the hand-over
admin.map_markers.hint.towTruck: The tow truck coming to you. Shows in every Radio Silence mode while it is on (shipped on).
admin.map_markers.hint.impoundDrop: Where the tow truck waits to load the car
admin.map_markers.hint.coronerVan: The coroner van (morgue) coming to the scene
admin.map_markers.hint.coronerDrop: Where the coroner van waits for the body bags
admin.map_markers.hint.suspectVehicle: A suspect's car or a stopped car
admin.map_markers.hint.parkedCar: The parked cars of a scene
admin.map_markers.hint.witness: Witnesses and people to talk to
admin.map_markers.hint.hidingSpot: Where a fugitive hid, once he was found
admin.map_markers.hint.ambush: Ambush cars and attackers, once they appear
admin.map_markers.hint.hospitalDrop: The nearest hospital while a live-case suspect is down
admin.map_markers.hint.partner: The other officers of your run
admin.map_markers.hint.reportedPoint: A live case's reported scene and last-reported points
admin.map_markers.objective_hint: The one blip (or circle) and GPS line of the objective your officers are on, and how each kind of objective blip looks.
markers.console_aliases: Map markers: config.lua or the saved settings still use old names, read as the new ones this start (rename them in config/config.lua; saved settings were moved): {list}
